title.zh: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子
title.raw: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子 Volume 53 Biographies 23: Crown Prince Minhuai

value.zh: 愍懷太子
value.en: Crown Prince Minhuai
value.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai

value.zh: 太子性剛，知賈謐恃後之貴，不能假借之。
value.en: Yu refused to flatter Jia Mi.
value.literal: The crown prince's temper was stiff; knowing Jia Mi relied on the empress's power, he would not indulge him.

value.zh: 謐至東宮，或舍之而於後庭遊戲。
value.en: He left Jia Mi cooling heels while he played inside.
value.literal: When Mi came to the Eastern Palace he sometimes left him waiting while he played in the inner courts.

value.zh: 詹事裴權諫曰：「賈謐甚有寵于中宮，而有不順之色，若一旦交構，大事去矣。
value.en: Household Superintendent Pei Quan remonstrated: "Jia Mi is deeply favored in the inner palace yet shows disrespectful looks—if they ever turn on you, the great enterprise is lost.
value.literal: Household Superintendent Pei Quan remonstrated: 'Jia Mi is deeply favored in the inner palace yet shows disrespectful looks—if they ever turn on you, the great enterprise is lost.

value.zh: 宜深自謙屈，以防其變，廣延賢士，用自輔翼。」
value.en: You should humble yourself deeply to guard against change and broadly recruit worthy men to aid your wings."
value.literal: You should humble yourself deeply to guard against change and broadly recruit worthy men to aid your wings.'

value.zh: 太子不能從。
value.en: Yu ignored him.
value.literal: The crown prince would not follow.

value.zh: 初，賈后母郭槐欲以韓壽女為太子妃，太子亦欲婚韓氏以自固。
value.en: Guo Huai once pushed a Han match—Yu wanted it too.
value.literal: Earlier Empress Jia's mother Guo Huai had wished to take Han Shou's daughter as crown princess; the crown prince also wished to marry the Hans to strengthen himself.

value.zh: 而壽妻賈午及後皆不聽，而為太子聘王衍小女惠風。
value.en: Jia Wu and the empress forced Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng instead.
value.literal: But Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress both refused and instead betrothed the crown prince to Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng.

value.zh: 太子聞衍長女美，而賈后為謐聘之，心不能平，頗以為言。
value.en: Yu resented losing Wang's elder beauty to Jia Mi.
value.literal: The crown prince heard Wang's elder daughter was beautiful while the empress betrothed her to Jia Mi; his heart could not rest easy and he spoke of it often.

value.zh: 謐嘗與太子圍棋，爭道，成都王穎見而訶謐，謐意愈不平，因此譖太子于後曰：「太子廣買田業，多畜私財以結小人者，為賈氏故也。
value.en: Once while playing go with the crown prince Mi quarreled over a move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and slandered the crown prince to the empress: "The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.
value.literal: Once Mi played go with the crown prince and they quarreled over the move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and therefore slandered the crown prince to the empress: 'The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.

value.zh: 密聞其言云：'皇后萬歲後，吾當魚肉之。
value.en: Mi quoted Yu vowing to slaughter the Jias after Jia died.
value.literal: I have secretly heard him say: "After the empress dies, I shall butcher them."

value.zh: '非但如是也，若宮車晏駕，彼居大位，依楊氏故事，誅臣等而廢後於金墉，如反手耳。
value.en: Not only that—if the imperial carriage halts and he reaches the great seat, following Lady Yang's precedent he will execute us ministers and lock you away at Jinyong like turning his hand.
value.literal: Not only that—if the imperial carriage halts and he reaches the great seat, following Lady Yang's precedent he will execute us ministers and lock you away at Jinyong like turning his hand.

value.zh: 不如早為之所，更立慈順者以自防衛。」
value.en: Better strike early, remove him, and set up someone kindly and tractable to defend ourselves."
value.literal: Better strike early, remove him, and set up someone kindly and tractable to defend ourselves.'

value.zh: 後納其言，又宣揚太子之短，布諸遠近。
value.en: Jia adopted the plot and smeared Yu empire-wide.
value.literal: The empress accepted his words and further broadcast the crown prince's faults throughout near and far.

value.zh: 于時朝野咸知賈后有害太子意。
value.en: Everyone saw Jia meant to kill the heir.
value.literal: Then court and countryside knew the empress meant to harm the crown prince.

value.zh: 中護軍趙俊請太子廢後，太子不聽。
value.en: Zhao Jun urged preemptive deposition—Yu declined.
value.literal: Central Guard Zhao Jun asked the crown prince to depose the empress first; the crown prince refused.

value.zh: 資治通鑑 第097卷
value.en: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 97.
value.literal: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 97.

value.zh: 十一月，皝自將勁兵四萬出南道，以慕容翰、慕容霸為前鋒，別遣長史王寓等將兵萬五千出北道，以伐高句麗。
value.en: In the eleventh month Huang led forty thousand picked troops in person along the southern route, with Murong Han and Murong Ba as vanguard, while Chief Clerk Wang Yu and others took fifteen thousand men along the northern route against Koguryŏ.
value.literal: In the eleventh month Huang personally led forty thousand crack troops out the southern road, with Murong Han and Murong Ba as vanguard, and separately sent Chief Clerk Wang Yu and others with fifteen thousand men out the northern road to attack Koguryŏ.

value.zh: 高句麗王釗果遣弟武帥精兵五萬拒北道，自帥羸兵以備南道。
value.en: King Chao of Koguryŏ duly sent his brother Wu with fifty thousand elite troops to block the northern road, while he himself led weaker forces to face the south.
value.literal: King Chao of Koguryŏ indeed sent his brother Wu at the head of fifty thousand elite troops to block the northern road, while he himself led weak troops to guard the southern road.

value.zh: 慕容翰等先至，與釗合戰，皝以大眾繼之。
value.en: Murong Han's vanguard arrived first and engaged Chao; Huang came up with the main army.
value.literal: Murong Han and the others arrived first and joined battle with Chao; Huang followed with the main host.

value.zh: 左常侍鮮于亮曰：「臣以俘虜蒙王國士之恩，不可以不報；
value.en: Left Attendant-in-Ordinary Xianyu Liang said, "I was once a captive, yet Your Majesty treated me as a pillar of the state; I cannot fail to repay that debt;
value.literal: Left Attendant-in-Ordinary Xianyu Liang said, "Your servant, though once a captive, received the grace of the state's favor and cannot fail to repay it;

value.zh: 今日，臣死日也！」
value.en: today is the day I die!"
value.literal: today is the day your servant dies!"

value.zh: 獨與數騎先犯高句麗陣，所向摧陷。
value.en: He charged the Koguryŏ line at the head of only a few horsemen and broke through wherever he struck.
value.literal: He alone with a few horsemen was first to charge the Koguryŏ line, breaking through wherever he turned.

value.zh: 高句麗陣動，大眾因而乘之，高句麗兵大敗。
value.en: The Koguryŏ line buckled; the main army pressed the advantage and routed them completely.
value.literal: The Koguryŏ formation wavered; the great host pressed the advantage and the Koguryŏ army was utterly defeated.

value.zh: 左長史韓壽斬高句麗將阿佛和度加，諸軍乘勝追之，遂入丸都。
value.en: Left Chief Clerk Han Shou slew the Koguryŏ general Afohedujia; the armies pursued the victory and entered Wandu.
value.literal: Left Chief Clerk Han Shou slew the Koguryŏ general Afohedujia; the armies pursued in victory and entered Wandu.

value.zh: 釗單騎走，輕車將軍慕輿泥追獲其母周氏及妻而還。
value.en: Chao fled alone; Light-Carriage General Murong Ni pursued and captured his mother, Lady Zhou, and his wife before returning.
value.literal: Chao fled alone on horseback; Light-Carriage General Murong Ni pursued and captured his mother Lady Zhou and his wife before returning.

value.zh: 會王寓等戰於北道，皆敗沒，由是皝不復窮追。
value.en: Meanwhile Wang Yu's force on the northern road was destroyed; for that reason Huang did not press the pursuit further.
value.literal: Meanwhile Wang Yu and the others fought on the northern road and were all defeated and lost; for this reason Huang did not press the pursuit to the end.

value.zh: 遣使招釗，釗不出。
value.en: He sent envoys to summon Chao, but Chao would not submit.
value.literal: He sent envoys to summon Chao; Chao did not come forth.

value.zh: 皝將還，韓壽曰：「高句麗之地，不可戍守。
value.en: As Huang prepared to withdraw, Han Shou said, "Koguryŏ cannot be held by garrisons.
value.literal: As Huang was about to withdraw, Han Shou said, "The land of Koguryŏ cannot be garrisoned.

value.zh: 今其主亡民散，潛伏山谷；
value.en: Their king has fled and the people are scattered in the hills;
value.literal: Now their ruler is fled and the people scattered, hiding in mountain valleys;

value.zh: 大軍既去，必復鳩聚，收其餘燼，猶足為患。
value.en: once our army leaves they will rally again, and even the embers they gather will be enough to trouble us.
value.literal: once the great army departs they will surely gather again; gathering the embers that remain, they will still be enough to cause trouble.

value.zh: 請載其父屍、囚其生母而歸，俟其束身自歸，然後返之，撫以恩信，策之上也。」
value.en: Carry off his father's corpse and take his mother prisoner; when he comes to surrender in person, return them and win him with kindness and trust—that is the best policy."
value.literal: I ask that we carry off his father's corpse and take his living mother prisoner; wait until he binds himself and comes to surrender, then return them and treat him with favor and trust—this is the supreme stratagem."

value.zh: 皝從之。
value.en: Huang agreed.
value.literal: Huang followed this advice.

value.zh: 發釗父乙弗利墓。
value.en: They opened the tomb of Chao's father Yifuli.
value.literal: They opened the tomb of Chao's father Yifuli.

value.zh: 載其屍，收其府庫累世之寶，虜男女五萬餘口，燒其宮室，毀丸都城而還。
value.en: They carried off the corpse, seized the hoarded treasures of generations, took more than fifty thousand captives, burned the palaces, razed the walls of Wandu, and withdrew.
value.literal: They carried off the corpse, seized the treasures accumulated in the royal storehouses for generations, captured more than fifty thousand men and women, burned the palaces, destroyed the walls of Wandu, and returned.

value.en: Han Shou
value.zh: 韓壽
韓

value.event: Han Shou was the proposed father-in-law in Guo Huai's marriage plan; no calendar date is stated.

value.en: Han Shou
value.zh: 韓壽

value.event: slew a Koguryŏ general in the eleventh month of the eighth year of Xiankang (AD 342; possibly early AD 343) (outside-knowledge conversion)

value.statement: Koguryŏ cannot be garrisoned; carry off the father's corpse and the mother to force the king's surrender
